name: Dizzy Stars
summary: Ring of small stars orbiting around a head: place over a head for dizzy or knocked out.

params.name: s
params.note: scale; about 490 px wide at s = 1

params.name: color
params.note: star colour; a darker edge is added

params.name: anim
params.note: orbit = stars circle the head, spin = stars also turn

params.name: popIn
params.note: springs in over the first 10 frames
